04 / BUILT FOR THE BAD DAYS

A backup is not successful
because a command ran.

MiChecklist treats a job as complete only after its output is checked. When permissions, locked files, or interrupted processes get in the way, the report explains what happened in operational language.

01Verify before success

Output existence, compression, and SHA-256 integrity are checked before completion.

02Recover interrupted work

Persistent queues, startup recovery, heartbeat monitoring, and retries protect scheduled jobs.

03Preserve the latest valid backup

Retention can clean older artifacts without deleting the newest proven recovery point.

04Make warnings actionable

Permission failures and locked files identify the exact item and the reason it needs attention.
